normalizedAccounting.steady: For each client, max(original65sStart,firstAPIAt+2000) <= request.at <= original65sEnd. These sets are disjoint; no request is exactly at the cutoff in these observations.

normalizedAccounting.why: Bootstrap-ready did not mean every parallel postflight HEAD was complete. Startup HEADs appearing in the65s phase are kept in raw records and classified by their original timestamps; no product code or assertion changed.
normalizedAccounting.rate: Counts divided by the sum of actual per-client normalized exposure milliseconds. Individual exposures exceed63s and are not replaced with a60s/65s denominator.
